name: Fresh Canna | 1g Live Resin Infused RSO Dart | Pineapple Express
description: Fresh Canna’s Pineapple Express Live Resin Infused RSO is a vibrant, uplifting fusion designed to energize the day. Bursting with tropical notes of ripe pineapple and citrus, this strain’s flavor is as bold as its effects. The live resin infusion enhances the potency of RSO, offering a smooth yet powerful experience that promotes creativity, focus, and a cheerful mood. Perfect for daytime enjoyment or whenever you need a boost, Pineapple Express combines flavor, strength, and inspiration in every serving.
